name: Special City Council Meeting- Town Hall
agenda_text:
September 24, 2026
  6:00 P.M
  Palos Verdes Golf Course
  3301 Via Campesina
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

  AGENDA
  SPECIAL TOWN HALL MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 24, 2026, CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES

Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to
make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in
the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons
with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the
City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-
related modification or accommodation.

Members of the public may address the City Council concerning any item on this Special
Meeting Agenda before or during consideration of that item. Comments shall be limited
to up to three (3) minutes per speaker unless otherwise directed by the Mayor. Because
this is a special meeting, the City Council may only consider business listed on this
agenda. No action will be taken on matters not appearing on the agenda. Speakers are
requested to complete a speaker card and provide it to the City Clerk prior to speaking.

This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid format, allowing members of the public
to attend in person or remotely using the teleconference or videoconference
information provided below.

  REMOTE MEETING PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Zoom Meeting Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82463104133
  Meeting ID: 824 6310 4133
  Dial-In Number: (669) 900-9128

  HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are
encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityClerks@pvestates.org before
 the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all council members. Public
correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the
legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.

  HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address
the City Council during the meeting while participating remotely, please utilize the
"Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityClerks@pvestates.org with
(1) the agenda item on which you’d like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or
Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda
Item are available on the City’s website under City Council Meeting Agendas at
www.pvestates.org.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

DISCUSSION: CITY COUNCIL TOWN HALL REGARDING MEASURE PVE

  1. PRESENTATION

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026, AT 6:30 P.M

  I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of
  California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin
  Boards located by front door located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos
  Verdes Estates, CA 90274, and on the City’s Website (pvestates.org) not less
  than 24 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code
  Section 54954.2. Dated this 22nd day of September 2026. Dayna Williams-
  Hunter,CMC, Interim City Clerk.
